name: Traditional Congkak Board Display
description: Original static Malaysian congkak exhibit: one timber board with two rows of seven deep wells, two larger end wells and a few staged seed counters.
summary: Original continuous carved board with fourteen small bowls and two larger end houses, displayed with nine plain seed-like props.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: Original curved solid wood body, integral concave carvings, quiet procedural point color, physically seated seed models and Cycles studio render.
rights: Original project asset; redistribution terms for public downloads are not specified.
accuracy_notes: Static interpretive display with no playable positions or rules. Common regional form, not the only layout. No artifact copy or claimed historical measurements.

attribution.credit: All geometry, colors, visible labels and images are original.
